lines.q: Before pumpkins, Irish jack-o'-lanterns were carved from what?
lines.a: Turnips! Pumpkins came later, in America.

lines.q: What is the fear of Halloween called?
lines.a: Samhainophobia! Phasmophobia is the fear of ghosts.
